name: Perth Airport

curfew.v: no curfew (no restrictions on night movements) at Perth Airport, per Airservices
curfew.quote: Why isn't there a curfew (restrictions on night movements) at Perth Airport?

notes: Read: RDS YPPH effective 09 Jul 2026 (runway 03/21 TORA 3444 m, 06/24 TORA 2163 m) and DAP aerodrome chart PPHAD01-186 (labels '3444 x 45' and '2163 x 45'). The ERSA facilities page could not be opened: https://www.airservicesaustralia.com/aip/pending/ersa/FAC_YPPH_09JUL2026.pdf (blocked) and FAC_YPPH_27NOV2025.pdf (site error), so customs, fuel, slots, parking and handling are not verified. The no-curfew fact comes from an Airservices Engage Q&A heading on the Perth new runway project (the answer says curfews are set by the Department of Infrastructure); the Commonwealth curfew page lists only Sydney, Adelaide, Gold Coast and Essendon Fields. Western Australia has no daylight time (UTC+8).
